name: tabular_group_cv_clean
title: Entity-grouped churn: GroupShuffleSplit + StratifiedGroupKFold + in-fold target encoding + CatBoost early stopping on the inner validation Pool
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-tabular: the correct half of the grouped-CV pair

forbidden.why: the only transformer fit in this project is encoder.fit_transform at lines 76 and 95, and both run AFTER the split they are downstream of - line 76 is inside the fold body that folds.split opened at line 69, line 95 is on train_x, which GroupShuffleSplit produced at line 45
TargetEncoder.fit and FrequencyEncoder.fit learn state from the rows they were handed, which is what fit means; a transformer class is never itself a leak
every column engineer() builds is a function of its own row - a ratio, a clip and a log - and nothing in features.py is fitted at all
test_x reaches exactly two calls, encoder.transform at line 102 and predict_proba at line 103; nothing is ever fitted on it or on a validation fold
no split exists inside encoders.py, so no value there can carry VAL_SPLIT or TEST_SPLIT
there is no cross_val_score / cross_validate / *SearchCV call in this project; the fold loop refits the encoder itself at line 76
the table has no timestamp: no parse_dates=, no to_datetime, no sort by a date column, and the grouping key is an account id
tenure_months is a duration, not a date; nothing here parses or sorts a timestamp
the only metrics are roc_auc_score and average_precision_score, both in the score-metric carve-out, and both are fed a predict_proba column
roc_auc_score is fed booster.predict_proba(...)[:, 1] at lines 86/103 - a score column, never predict()
seed_everything() seeds random and numpy at lines 36-37, GroupShuffleSplit and StratifiedGroupKFold both carry random_state=SEED, and CatBoost carries random_seed=SEED
GroupShuffleSplit at line 44 and StratifiedGroupKFold at line 65 both pass random_state=SEED
there is no torch in this project and no hand-written gradient step
model.eval() is a torch idiom; CatBoost has no train/eval mode to forget
torch.no_grad() has no meaning in a CatBoost program
no device is ever named in this project
nothing is pickled or loaded here; the booster is returned, not written

notes: Group leakage - one account_id appearing on both sides of a cut - has no rule in the catalogue, so the correct handling here (GroupShuffleSplit at line 44, StratifiedGroupKFold at line 65, the grouping key threaded through both) cannot be scored. It is the defect the defective twin plants and the reason this pair exists.
MLV107 (early stopping on the test set) is catalogued but not implemented, so the correct choice here - eval_set=valid_pool at line 83, built from the inner fold - carries no forbidden label.
